title: Never-diagnosed incident reported as SUPPORTED
bug_report:
Found during a live UI walkthrough. I created a brand-new incident (symptom "boom", service shop_api) and did not run any diagnosis on it, so it sits in state CREATED with no cause class and no diagnosis data. `GET /incidents/{id}/report` nevertheless returns `root_cause.status` = "SUPPORTED", and the UI shows a green 'supported' root cause for an incident nobody has analysed. Expected: the report must not present an undiagnosed incident as having a supported root cause.

Observed in the JSON of the report endpoint and in the UI badge.
